import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define GSL function prototypes
# gsl_bspline_alloc
gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

# gsl_bspline_ncontrol
gsl.gsl_bspline_ncontrol.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl.gsl_bspline_ncontrol.restype = ctypes.c_size_t

# gsl_bspline_init_uniform
gsl.gsl_bspline_init_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl.gsl_bspline_init_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_int

# gsl_bspline_eval_deriv_basis
gsl.gsl_bspline_eval_deriv_basis.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl.gsl_bspline_eval_deriv_basis.restype = ctypes.c_int

# gsl_matrix_alloc
gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

# gsl_matrix_free
gsl.gsl_matrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl.gsl_matrix_free.restype = None

# gsl_matrix_get
gsl.gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

# gsl_bspline_free
gsl.gsl_bspline_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl.gsl_bspline_free.restype = None

def compute_bspline_derivatives():
    nbreak = 6
    spline_order = 4
    n = 300
    a = 0.0
    b = 1.0
    dx = (b - a) / (n - 1.0)

    # Allocate B-spline workspace
    w = gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc(spline_order, nbreak)
    p = gsl.gsl_bspline_ncontrol(w)

    # Allocate matrix for derivatives
    dB = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(p, spline_order)

    # Initialize uniform B-spline
    gsl.gsl_bspline_init_uniform(a, b, w)

    results = []

    for i in range(spline_order):
        for j in range(n):
            xj = j * dx
            gsl.gsl_bspline_eval_deriv_basis(xj, i, dB, w)

            row = [xj]
            for k in range(p):
                value = gsl.gsl_matrix_get(dB, k, i)
                row.append(value)
            results.append(row)

    # Free allocated memory
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(dB)
    gsl.gsl_bspline_free(w)

    return results

def assert_test():
    results = compute_bspline_derivatives()

    # Validate the output structure
    assert isinstance(results, list), "Output should be a list."
    assert len(results) > 0, "Output list should not be empty."
    for row in results:
        assert isinstance(row, list), "Each row should be a list."
        assert len(row) > 1, "Each row should contain at least one x value and one derivative."

    # Validate numerical values
    for row in results:
        xj = row[0]
        assert 0.0 <= xj <= 1.0, "x values should be within the range [0, 1]."
        for value in row[1:]:
            assert isinstance(value, float), "Derivative values should be floats."

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
